hypothesis: TRAIN-learned contingent ranking of which shared-variable second public observation to buy next can exploit S3 structural information while preserving sound exact answers and complete resource parity versus equally trained certificate and full exact symbolic controls.

source.domain: S3 only, 3 shared role variables, novel source words with distinct identities
source.candidate_visible: only first public role pairs; second role pair only through chosen query

mechanism.name: trainable contingent public ambiguity reduction
mechanism.training: 40 TRAIN cases, all training outcomes public only; train a deterministic bounded feature-weighted role selection ranker; no hidden oracle identities or DEV labels
mechanism.decision: After each purchased second pair, recompute ranking using only observed evidence. Never inspect unqueried public pairs.
mechanism.soundness: Use immutable exact shared-role certificate; cap exhaustion means UNKNOWN, never a guessed answer; fallback to frozen exact public solution.

measurement.public_service_cost: instrument or qualify as UNMEASURED, never assert remote service parity
measurement.windows_clock_resolution: zero-quantized CPU is not zero compute
